subject: general
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
Bathsheba realized too late that Gabriel Oak had been better** man for her all along.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. best .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence implies a comparison between Gabriel Oak and other men in Bathsheba's life. The use of the superlative form is necessary to indicate that Gabriel Oak was the most suitable or fitting man for her.
 
• The word **"better"** is the comparative form of "good" and is used for comparisons between two entities, but here the context calls for the superlative form **"best"** to indicate the highest degree of suitability.
 
• Thus, "best" is the correct replacement for the phrase "better man" in the given sentence.

Correct sentence: *Bathsheba realized too late that Gabriel Oak had been the **best** man for her all along.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Superlative Adjectives:**
 
 
• Superlative adjectives are used to compare one entity to all others in a group, indicating the highest or lowest degree of a quality.
 
• Formed by adding **"-est"** to short adjectives (e.g., big → biggest) or using **"most"** for longer adjectives (e.g., beautiful → most beautiful).
 
 
 
• **Comparative Adjectives:**
 
 
• Used to compare two entities, indicating a greater or lesser degree of a quality.
 
• Formed by adding **"-er"** to short adjectives (e.g., small → smaller) or using **"more"** for longer adjectives (e.g., interesting → more interesting).
